theater: 河西走廊西段至金山北麓

battle.name: 隋擊鐵勒之戰
battle.theater: 河西走廊西段至金山北麓
battle.brief: 大業三年（607）四月，隋煬帝發兵百三十萬、號百萬，分道西征吐谷渾與鐵勒。李靖率軍在赤水源與積石山一線擊潰吐谷渾王庭，隨後置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡；鐵勒一部西走、一部內附。卡面的斯巴達長矛屬希臘方陣兵器，與本役相隔一千四百餘年，並不在隋軍武備之列。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋煬帝大業三年（607）以西征名義對北方草原部族與西域通道發動的一場軍事行動，交戰對象是吐谷渾與鐵勒兩支。隋的一方是中央集權的隋朝，由煬帝楊廣在長安發令，從河西走廊的武威、張掖、酒泉、敦煌四郡調兵，兵分兩路：西海道指向青海一帶的吐谷渾，金山道指向蒙古高原西部的鐵勒。隋軍的主體並非常備禁軍，而是以府兵為骨架、臨時徵發的州縣鄉兵與丁役湊成的混合部隊，另配騎兵、攻城器械與大批隨軍丁夫，各路主將由行軍大將軍級的將領分道率領。《隋書·西域傳》記鐵勒分十餘部，與柔然接壤於金山以北，控弦之眾號稱二十餘萬，部眾以游騎為主，居無城郭，逐水草而徙。吐谷渾則據青海與鄯善一線，控弦數萬，有自己的王庭與騎兵精銳。這不是一場兩國對兩國的決戰，而是中央王朝以壓倒性的人力與投射距離，向一個沒有固定疆界的草原世界施加壓力；戰事同時牽動西域商旅、柔然、突厥與河西邊軍的整條補給線。
countriesEn: This war was a military campaign launched by Emperor Yang of the Sui in the third year of the Daye era (607) under the banner of a western expedition, directed against two steppe peoples and at the same time aimed at reopening the corridor into the Western Regions: the Tuyuhun and the Tiele. The Sui side was the centralised Sui court, which issued its orders from Chang'an and drew its troops from the four commanderies of the Hexi Corridor — Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Dunhuang — then split them into two prongs. The route of the Sea of the West pointed at the Tuyuhun in the Qinghai region, the route of the Gold Mountain at the Tiele in the western Mongolian plateau. The bulk of the Sui host was not a standing army: it was a mixed mass cobbled together from the fubing skeleton and from county militia and corvée labour called up on the spot, supplemented by cavalry, siege equipment and a very large train of service labourers, each prong led by commanders of the xingjun dajiangjun grade. The Sui shu, in its account of the Western Regions, describes the Tiele as split into a dozen-odd tribes, touching the Rouran to the north of the Gold Mountain, with more than two hundred thousand men under bow-strings; they were essentially a people of mounted raiders, living without walled towns and following the water and the grass. The Tuyuhun held the Qinghai and the Shanshan line, with tens of thousands under the bow and a royal court of their own backed by veteran cavalry. This was not a set-piece war between two states but an attempt by a centralised court, with overwhelming numbers and reach, to press upon a steppe world that had no fixed frontiers; and the fighting at the same time dragged in the merchant traffic of the Western Regions, the Rouran, the Turks and the whole supply chain of the Hexi frontier garrisons.
people: 最高決策者是隋煬帝楊廣。大業三年四月，他在河南道與河北道元氣未復的狀態下下詔「發兵百三十萬，號百萬」，把西征同時當作新朝武功的展示與內部危機的轉移手段。真正主導吐谷渾戰線的是西海道行軍元帥李靖：他以輕騎為先鋒，循河而進，避開吐谷渾的正面鋒芒，直趨其王庭所在的赤水源與積石山一線，迫得其名王西走。鐵勒一路的將佐，《隋書·西域傳》只留下「遣行軍元禮」這類簡略記載，具體的指揮分工與戰鬥經過在史籍中十分零碎，這本身就是這場戰爭留下記錄最少的地方之一。推動西域經營的是裴矩一類的官員：大業年間他在張掖招徠西域商旅，撰成《西域圖記》，把諸國物產、戶口與道里整理成圖冊，直接為這場遠征提供了地理與經濟的依據。另一個不容忽略的參與者是河北與河南道的丁夫與鄉兵：他們被徵發押運糧秣、趕著牲畜隨軍西行，根本沒有戰鬥的機會，卻承擔了遠征最重的負擔。十一月，王薄在河北長平鄉聚眾起事，以「無向遼東浪死歌」散傳各地，把對這場西征的怨恨直接變成反隋的旗幟。
peopleEn: The supreme decision was Emperor Yang of the Sui, Yang Guang. In the fourth month of Daye 3 (607), while Henan and Hebei had yet to recover their strength, he issued the order to raise one million three hundred thousand men and call it one million, turning the expedition at once into a display of the new dynasty's martial achievement and a means of diverting unrest at home. The man who actually directed the Tuyuhun front was Li Jing, appointed xingjun yuanshuai of the route of the Sea of the West: with light cavalry leading he moved along the river, slipped past the Tuyuhun's main blow and drove straight for the royal seat at the Red Water Source and the Jishi Mountains, forcing their named king westward. For the Tiele front the Sui shu preserves only cursory notices such as the sending of xingjun Yuanli; the division of command and the course of the fighting are very fragmentary in the historical record, and that thinness is itself one of the most striking features of this war. The man who pushed the Western Regions policy was an official of the type of Pei Ju: in the Daye years he drew Western merchants to Zhangye and compiled the Xiyu Tuji, the Illustrated Record of the Western Regions, setting out the products, populations and stage distances of the states along the road as a dossier on which to campaign. Another participant who must not be forgotten was the corvée labour and the county militia of Hebei and Henan: they were conscripted to drive grain and draught animals west with the army, were given no chance to fight, and yet bore the heaviest share of the expedition's weight. In the eleventh month Wang Bo rose at Changping township in Hebei, singing that no one should sing a song of dying for Liaodong, and the resentment born of this expedition was turned directly into a banner of rebellion against the Sui.
kits: 卡面的兵器是古希臘的斯巴達長矛：兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，是重裝步兵方陣裡用來頂盾、封住陣線缺口的長柄刺擊武器。它與大業三年的隋軍沒有任何裝備上的關係——兩者相隔一千四百餘年，一件屬於前五世紀希臘城邦的民兵體系，一件從未出現在隋朝的武備清冊裡；本卡把它放在這場戰爭面前，比較的正是在同一角色下的兩次運用。隋軍對應的兵器是槊與矛：步兵用長約一丈的槊配盾成列，騎兵用槊作衝鋒與近戰，兩米這個長度正是實務上「槊」的量級。防具方面，隋軍有柳葉甲、兜鍪與大盾，重甲騎兵即後來聞名於隋唐的玄甲騎；遠射手武器有弓與弩，攻城則靠雲梯、撞車、巢車與拋石用的霹靂車，隨軍還有大量裝載糧秣的牛馬車隊。草原方面，鐵勒與吐谷渾以弓矢為主，騎兵用彎刀與短矛，配皮甲與骨飾。兩邊真正可比之處不在鐵甲，而在密度——同樣是密集的長柄兵器在同一瞬間決定陣線的成敗。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face is the Greek Spartan dory: a two-metre wooden spear with a bronze shoe on the butt, the long thrusting weapon with which the hoplite phalanx bore down on shields and closed the gaps in the line. It has no equipment relationship at all with the Sui army of Daye 3 — the two are more than fourteen centuries apart, one belonging to the fifth-century BC citizen militia of the Greek poleis, the other never appearing in any Sui inventory of arms. This card sets it before the war in order to compare two uses of the same weapon role. The Sui counterpart was the shao and the mao: infantry carried shao of about one zhang in length and stood in line with shields, cavalry used the shao for the charge and for close combat, and a length of two metres is exactly the order of magnitude of the shao. For protection the Sui had willow-leaf armour, helmets and large shields, together with the armoured cavalry that became famous as the xuanjia riders; the missile weapons were bows and crossbows, and for siege they had scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and stone-throwing devices for hurling boulders, with a great number of oxen, horses and wagons loaded with grain. On the steppe side the Tiele and the Tuyuhun fought with bows above all, their cavalry using curved sabres and short spears with leather armour and bone ornaments. The real point of comparison between the two is not iron but density: in both cases the long-hafted weapon held in mass decided the line at one and the same moment.
tactics: 大業三年四月出兵的部署是典型的多路鉗形：主力沿河西走廊北緣西行，經敦煌出玉門關，進入西域與蒙古西部；一路指向青海的吐谷渾王庭，一路指向金山的鐵勒諸部。行軍途中以遊騎充當斥候與前導，遇到草原部眾則以騎兵大隊進行追擊與包抄，步兵結成方陣鞏固已占據的城障與水草，攻城時再以撞車與雲梯壓上。與吐谷渾的交戰重點是奇襲與不戰而迫其西徙：李靖部先鋒避開正面，長驅直插赤水源、積石山一線，擊潰其王庭主力，殘部西走，隋軍隨即在殘破聚落上設郡置縣，安置降部並施行羈縻。對鐵勒，隋廷的辦法是軍事施壓與羈縻並用：騎兵追擊其分散的部眾，同時封官、賜馬、編入部落，換取內附。整條戰線最弱的一環在後勤：從敦煌到金山直線約一千公里，糧食要靠屯田與徵發的丁夫、牛車一站站往前送，騎兵可以急行，步兵與攻城器械卻走不快，一旦鐵勒避戰遠走、糧道拉長，遠征軍的士氣與補給就會同時繃緊。
tacticsEn: The deployment for the campaign of the fourth month of Daye 3 was a classic pincer: the main body moved west along the northern edge of the Hexi Corridor, passed through Dunhuang and out of the Yumen Pass into the Western Regions and the western Mongolian plateau; one prong aimed at the Tuyuhun royal seat by the Qinghai, the other at the Tiele tribes around the Gold Mountain. Light cavalry served as scouts and advance guides on the march; meeting steppe hosts it fell to the cavalry bands to pursue and envelop, while the infantry formed up in square to consolidate the forts and watering places already taken, and only at the walls did the rams and the scaling ladders go forward. The fighting against the Tuyuhun turned on a combination of striking by surprise and of breaking the enemy without a set battle: Li Jing's leading troops avoided the front, made a long rush to the Red Water Source and the Jishi Mountains, broke the Tuyuhun royal host and scattered it, and the Sui then set up commanderies and counties on the ruined settlements, settling the surrendered tribes and applying the jimi arrangement. Against the Tiele the Sui combined military pressure with jimi control: cavalry pursued their scattered bands while at the same time conferring titles, giving horses and drawing them into the tribes, in exchange for their submission. The weakest link in the whole front was logistics. From Dunhuang to the Gold Mountain is roughly a thousand kilometres in a straight line, and grain had to be moved forward stage by stage by the garrison farms and by conscripted labour and ox carts. Cavalry could hurry; infantry and siege engines could not. And once the Tiele declined battle and drew away and the grain road was stretched, the morale and the supply of the expedition army would tighten together.
data: 可核的數字有幾組。第一組是兵員：《資治通鑑》記大業三年四月「發兵百三十萬，號百萬」，這是全軍的號令數，實際作戰部隊遠少於此，其中常備府兵與禁軍只是骨架，絕大多數是臨時徵發的州縣鄉兵；而被徵發的運輸丁夫，數量往往不下於作戰兵員。第二組是戰果：五月與吐谷渾戰於赤水源，《通鑑》記「斬首數萬級」，其後追奔至積石山一線，吐谷渾王庭崩潰，隋廷隨即置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡，總管府設在鄯善縣（《隋書·地理志》）。第三組是對手的規模：《隋書·西域傳》稱鐵勒分十餘部，控弦之眾二十餘萬，這是史家的概數，不是點名冊。第四組是距離與時間：從敦煌出玉門關到鐵勒核心的金山北麓，直線約一千公里，按每日百里的騎乘速度，單程需半月至一月；四月出兵、七月兵鋒抵張掖、十月車駕還京，前後約三個月的行程，正好趕上高原降雪前最後的窗口。第五組是財政：遠征耗去的轉輸與丁役，直接抽空了河北與河南道的丁口。
dataEn: There are several groups of figures that can be checked. The first is the strength of the army: the Zizhi Tongjian records that in the fourth month of Daye 3 Yang raised one million three hundred thousand men and called it one million. That is a paper figure for the whole force; the actual fighting strength was far smaller, the standing fubing and the palace troops being only a skeleton, with the overwhelming majority hastily conscripted county levies, while the number of service labourers conscripted for transport was often no less than the number of soldiers. The second group is the result of the fighting: in the fifth month the army fought the Tuyuhun at the Red Water Source, the Tongjian records the cutting off of tens of thousands of heads, the pursuit then ran to the Jishi Mountains, the Tuyuhun royal court collapsed, and the Sui court at once set up the four commanderies of Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan and Qiemu with the headquarters of the zongguan fu placed at Shanshan county, as recorded in the treatise on geography of the Sui shu. The third group is the scale of the opponent: the Sui shu says the Tiele were divided into more than ten tribes with more than two hundred thousand men under bow-strings, a round number from the historian rather than a roll of names. The fourth group is distance and time: from Dunhuang through the Yumen Pass to the heartland of the Tiele on the northern slopes of the Gold Mountain is about a thousand kilometres in a straight line, and at a riding pace of a hundred li a day the outward leg took from half a month to a full month; the army set out in the fourth month, reached Zhangye in the seventh and the imperial carriage returned to the capital in the tenth, a run of about three months that hit the last window before the snow came down on the plateau. The fifth group is fiscal: the transport and the labour consumed by the expedition drained the households of Hebei and Henan.
cause: 大業初年，隋朝的西邊並不安寧。河西走廊的商道被吐谷渾與鐵勒各部切斷，敦煌、張掖一線的邊軍屯田屢遭掠奪，隋廷遣出的使節往來不絕，帶回的只是塞外部眾「不奉正朔」的實情；另一方面，統一不過數年的王朝需要一個能昭示武功的機會，而北面的突厥與東面的高句麗一時難以用兵，於是河西與西域成了最方便的用兵方向。制度上的準備早已做好：文帝時已在河西置四郡、經營屯田與馬場，煬帝即位後在張掖設市招徠西域商旅，裴矩整理的《西域圖記》把沿途諸國的物產、戶口與道里寫成可以據以出兵的圖冊。加上大業元年、二年北伐突厥與貝州之亂的餘波需要收拾，朝廷需要一場乾淨的勝利來重建威望，於是把兩個目標合為一次：既要打通西域商道、恢復河西四郡的實控，也要用一場勝利把內部的怨氣引向塞外。七月兵鋒抵達張掖、西巡續推至焉支山一線時，煬帝的排場把這場戰爭的代價具體化了——從這裡到京師，糧秣、牲口與人力全靠沿途州縣現籌。
causeEn: In the early Daye years the Sui's western frontier was not quiet. The trade road along the Hexi Corridor was cut by the Tuyuhun and by the Tiele bands, the frontier farms along the Dunhuang and Zhangye line were repeatedly raided, and the envoys the court sent out came back with nothing but reports that the peoples beyond the passes did not acknowledge the calendar. At the same time a dynasty unified for only a few years needed a chance to display its martial prowess, and since the Turks to the north and Goguryeo to the east could not be taken on at that moment, the Hexi and the Western Regions became the most convenient direction in which to use troops. The institutional groundwork had long been laid: under Wen four commanderies had been set up in the Hexi with farms and horse pastures opened, and once Yang took the throne a market was established at Zhangye to draw Western traders, while the Xiyu Tuji compiled by Pei Ju set out the products, the populations and the stage distances of the states along the road as a map on which to campaign. Add to this the unfinished business of the northern campaigns against the Turks in Daye 1 and 2 and of the revolt at Beizhou, and the court needed a clean victory to rebuild its prestige; the two aims were therefore merged into one expedition, meant both to open the Western trade route and restore real control of the four Hexi commanderies, and to use a victory to lead the anger of the people abroad. When the army's reach arrived at Zhangye in the seventh month and the imperial tour pushed on to the Yanzhi Mountains, the cost of this war was made concrete: from there to the capital, grain, livestock and labour were all requisitioned on the spot from the prefectures along the way.
impact: 這一仗的直接結果是西域的重新開口。吐谷渾的王西走，隋廷在青海與鄯善一線置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡，總管府置於鄯善縣，把漢唐之間這段被柔然與吐谷渾遮蔽的道路重新接回河西走廊；鐵勒諸部受挫之後，一部分西走或內附，隋廷以封號與羈縻的方式將各部編入新的秩序。三年之後隋朝崩潰，唐朝接手時，制約西域的仍是同一批草原部眾：唐太宗在貞觀年間平定東突厥，又在金山一帶置燕然都護府安置鐵勒諸部，那一支後來發展成回紇，成了唐代北方邊疆的主體。另一面的代價更為沉重：百三十萬的號令數意味著數十萬丁口離鄉，數千里糧道的轉輸，最後都落在河北與河南道的農戶頭上。大業三年西征結束不到兩個月，王薄即在長平鄉起兵；此後七年，從山東到嶺南，從河北到河西，隋朝的郡縣秩序一處接一處地崩解，兵變、饑民與地方豪強把這場遠征抽乾的人力重新分配到自己的地盤上。隋朝在西域贏得的時間，不過是以內部的崩潰換來的。
impactEn: The direct result was the reopening of the Western Regions. The Tuyuhun king fled west, the Sui set up the four commanderies of Xihai, Heyuan, Shanshan and Qiemu along the Qinghai and the Shanshan line with the headquarters at Shanshan county, and the road between the Han and the Tang that had been blocked by the Rouran and the Tuyuhun was tied back into the Hexi Corridor; the Tiele bands, struck and scattered, partly moved west or submitted, and the Sui court drew them into the new order through titles and jimi arrangements. Three years later the Sui fell, and the Tang inherited the same steppe peoples as the constraint on the west: after Taizong had destroyed the Eastern Turks in the Zhenguan years he set up the Yanran Protectorate in the region of the Gold Mountain to settle the Tiele tribes, the line that would later develop into the Uyghur and become the main body of the Tang's northern frontier. The cost on the other side was heavier still. A call of one million three hundred thousand men meant hundreds of thousands of households leaving their fields, and a grain road of thousands of kilometres; all of it fell on the peasant households of Hebei and Henan. Less than two months after the western expedition ended, Wang Bo rose in rebellion at Changping township; over the next seven years, from Shandong to Lingnan and from Hebei to Hexi, the commandery-and-county order of the Sui dissolved piece by piece, and mutiny, famine and the local strongmen took the manpower that the expedition had drained and redistributed it onto their own ground. In short, the time the Sui won in the west was bought with a collapse at home.
result: 從戰場上看，隋朝贏了：吐谷渾的王庭被端掉，四郡建立，鐵勒的部眾在西征中被壓得抬不起頭，一段被打斷的商道重新開通，隋室的聲威在張掖一線得到一次實地的演示。從結果上看，隋朝又沒有一件事真正完成：鐵勒沒有被征服，只被打散和安撫，數年後又在北方草原恢復並壯大，成為回紇與突厥的源流；吐谷渾的餘部很快復叛，說明四郡只是紙面上的郡，隋廷在青海沒有常備軍，郡縣與羈縻之間的落差在西邊與東邊同時暴露。這場戰爭最確定的後果不在戰線以西，而在戰線以東：一名帝王的西巡、一份百三十萬人的徵發令、一條延伸到金山的一千公里糧道，把隋朝從一個可以打贏任何對手的王朝，變成一個連境內都無法維持秩序的王朝。大業十二年，江都兵變，隋亡。
resultEn: On the battlefield the Sui won: the Tuyuhun court was destroyed, four commanderies were established, the Tiele bands were crushed and could not lift their heads, an interrupted trade road was opened again, and the authority of the Sui house was demonstrated on the ground at Zhangye. In outcome the Sui finished nothing: the Tiele were not conquered, only scattered and pacified, and within a few years they recovered and grew in the northern steppe, becoming the source of the Uyghur and of the Turks; the remnants of the Tuyuhun soon rebelled again, which showed that the four commanderies were commanderies on paper only, that the Sui kept no standing force in Qinghai, and that the gap between commandery-county rule and jimi control was exposed in the west and in the east at one and the same time. The most certain consequence of this war lay not west of the front but east of it: one emperor's western tour, one conscription order for one million three hundred thousand men and one grain road of a thousand kilometres turned the Sui from a dynasty that could beat any opponent into one that could not keep order inside its own borders. In the twelfth year of Daye the mutiny at Jiangdu brought the Sui down.
